headline: Oil Prices Fall as Concerns Over Middle East Supply Disruptions Ease
summary: Global crude oil futures declined on Monday from six-month highs following reports of potential de-escalation between the United States and Iran.
why: Crude oil is the primary energy commodity driving global transport, refining margins, and inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Easing diplomatic tensions reduced the geopolitical risk premium built into oil contracts.

why_moved: Expectations of reduced military conflict between the US and Iran reduced immediate risk premiums on crude contracts.
